purpose: Implement the separate learning/collaboration-depth dimension DO IT / WITH ME / SHOW ME / EXPLAIN WHY / LET ME TRY on the normal Song Learning journey without conflating it with ASK/ADVISE/TRY/DO authority or granting execution permission.

lineage.outcome: The artist can choose how much agency N0TE should take for one real Song-learning job, receiving behavior that clearly leads, collaborates, demonstrates, explains, or stands back without changing action authority.
lineage.capability: Interaction depth independent from mutation authority

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-124 is a REQUIRED MINIMUM Gate-B blocker on Song / Produce / Learn. Live N0TE2 has authority, capability, Learning, Skill and consumer Song foundations but no first-class interaction-depth model. It outranks a broad cross-domain Context/History hub because it closes one explicit active SONG-01 journey contract without ballooning node scope.
completion_proof: all five canonical interaction-depth modes are first-class and consumer-reachable for a real active Song Learning episode
mode choice is a per-job request, not silently stored as permanent Artist preference or taste doctrine
DO IT requests maximum N0TE agency but never grants authority, eligibility, capability, approval or execution and reports truthful blocked/authority-required semantics when execution is not bound
WITH ME divides the next job into explicit N0TE and artist roles
SHOW ME remains read-only and demonstration-oriented
EXPLAIN WHY remains read-only and rationale/tradeoff-oriented
LET ME TRY leaves the action to the artist and positions N0TE for observation/feedback rather than mutation
interaction planning binds the exact active Song, exact Learning episode and the evidence/decision state rendered to the artist so stale plans fail closed
consumer mode selection does not mutate Song, Version, Session, Learning evidence/decision, Skill state, Focus, authority, DAW, provider or durable preference state
internal Song/Learning/Session identities remain out of visible browser markup
Origin, CSRF and one-shot replay protections apply to the mode-selection POST
GET remains pure and authored tests remain separate from executed evidence
non_scope: granting mutation authority from teaching mode
next_selection_rule: After landing or blockage, globally reselect across Context/History reachability, References, Compare/A-B, Creative Studio, audio-analysis substrate, DAW/OPS, Artist Team and all other Gate-B blockers.
